name: pirc
description: Private, forward-authenticated web client for persistent coding-agent sessions

scripts.build: bun run --filter @pirc/web build && cargo build --locked --release -p pirc-gateway -p pirc-node
scripts.test: bun test scripts/test && bun run --filter @pirc/web test
scripts.check: bun run version:check && bun run catalog:check && bun run browser-assets:check && bun run format:check && bun run check:rust && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:conformance
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && env -u PIRC_CONFORMANCE_BIN_DIR -u PIRC_CONFORMANCE_REQUIRED cargo test --locked --workspace
